category.reason: The task requires filtering train schedules by departure and arrival times, then comparing departure times to identify the latest qualifying train.

instruction.en: Click the booking button for the latest-departing train that departs at or after 14:15 and arrives at or before 20:30.
instruction.zh: 点击 20 点 30 分及之前到达且在 14 点 15 分及以后出发的车次中，出发最晚的车票的预定按钮。

reference.patch: Changed both instructions to select the booking button for the latest-departing train among those departing at or after 14:15 and arriving at or before 20:30, instead of the train departing at 14:00 and arriving before 20:00. Moved the ground truth from the G18 booking button to the G20 booking button and updated category.reason to describe the time filtering and comparison.
